summary: Rewrite CHANGELOG.md and add website release notes for the 42.7.12 security release and the 42.7.13 feature release, including per-author commit lists.

user_docs.evidence: Adds release-notes pages under docs/content/changelogs; the substance is reviewed under change_description.

change_description.evidence: The PR is the release notes; the website 'Commits by author' credits the same commits twice (#4063 under Vladimir Sitnikov and Davide Angelocola, #3848 under Vladimir Sitnikov and 'Devs', 'restore pre-describe' under Vladimir Sitnikov and bshehata), lists 'Devs' as an author, and the 104-commit count does not match the listed items; the PR body says only 'Update the docs and changelogs'.

security.evidence: Restates the CVE-2026-54291 advisory text for 42.7.12; wording only, matches the advisory scope.

backward_compat.evidence: No code; flushCacheOnDdl default-true behavior change is listed under Added rather than Changed, a release-notes point counted under change_description.

contradictions.evidence: Root CHANGELOG.md and the website 42.7.13 page list different items (e.g. BlobInputStream reset fix #4204 and build/i18n entries only on the website) and the same commit appears under two authors; docs touched in two places that should agree.

build_ci.evidence: No build files; Hugo front matter only.

plan.why: Docs-only release-notes PR; one reviewer cross-checks the two changelogs against git history.
